RagShortTexts: Is the Parmartine the high-ranking military horse of the empire?

Variants.Content: Parmartine horses are the empire's high-level military horses, and only mounted cavalry can ride them. They are tall and have a very stable lower body, but they are lighter in weight, have a smaller load capacity, and do not run very fast. However, they are well-behaved and easy to control. They have the greatest comparative advantage. They are also horses that are collected by rich people from all over the world. They are high-end products for horse enthusiasts. If you don’t understand Parma Ting horses, you are not qualified to be a qualified horse-shou.
